name: Binaural Nature
description: Nature music for headphones: places built from ambiences, creatures and weather, each using the two ears as part of the scene. Every sketch is a whole piece of two to four minutes, with sections that arrive and leave, a variation on the way and a slow ending that stops on its own. Rain falling around your head, a brook that runs past you, crickets hopping from ear to ear, a sea cave whose hum opens from a point into the rock, two storms that cross overhead, a campfire under turning stars, a dawn chorus placed all around, wind wandering through the pines, a whale circling beneath you and a tune hidden in a spring. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Rain Canopy
sketches.description: Headphones on: about three minutes of rain on the leaves above you. Drops fall at random points around your head, a fine mist differs in each ear and a 2 Hz delta drone fades in and out under a soft D minor pad. The rain swells into a downpour, eases, and slows to a stop.

sketches.name: Brook Crossing
sketches.description: A brook runs past you from left to right, a wren sings on the far bank and a thrush behind you, while a pluck sways between your ears on delays under a millisecond, like stepping from stone to stone. The bank and the stones come round twice before the crossing, and the walk slows to a stop after about two and a half minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)
song("intro@4 (bank@8 stones@8)*2 crossing@8 outro@4", "once")
tempomap("0:18 44:18 48:14")

// A brook running past you from left to right, starting again in every section
brook: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(saw.range(-120, 120).slow(8)).distance(2).posglide(.5).gain(.24)
breeze: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(bysec("crossing:.35 *:.2")).gain(.07)

// A wren on the far bank, a thrush behind you
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(70).distance(5).gain(.24).sections("bank crossing outro")
thrush: s("bird").slow(5).azimuth(-150).elevation(20).distance(6).gain(.18).exceptSections("intro")

// Stepping stones: under about 0.7 ms, a delay between the ears moves the pluck sideways
// In the last bar of each section, half the steps drop out, like a pause before a jump
stones: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 ~").scale("G:major pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").itd(sine.range(-.6, .6).slow(4))
  .decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.4).room(.4).gain(.2)
  .sections("stones crossing").atEnd(1, x => x.degradeBy(.5).seed("stones"))

// A soft centred bass, with no delay at all: G, Em, C, D
bass: note("<g2 e2 c2 d2>").s("sine").attack(.2).sustain(.7).release(.8)
  .gain(bysec("outro:.18 *:.28")).exceptSections("intro")

sketches.name: Night Meadow
sketches.description: Headphones on: from dusk to dawn in about three and a half minutes. Crickets chirp all around, close chirps hop between your ears and swap sides in the second meadow, frogs call from a pond behind you and an owl from far off. Slow choir chords and a 4 Hz binaural beat in the theta range sit underneath. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)
song("dusk@4 meadow@16 pond@8 meadow'@16 dawn@4", "once")
tempomap("0:14 44:14 48:11")

// Crickets in the grass on both sides
grass: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(-100).distance(4).gain(.08)
field: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(110).distance(6).gain(.07)

// Close chirps: ild makes the right ear louder; earswap flips the steps marked 1 to the left
// In the second meadow, variant turns ild around so the louder ear changes sides
chirps: s("click*8?0.5").hpf(4000).ild(9).earswap("0 1 1 0 1 0 0 1").seed("meadow").gain(.08)
  .exceptSections("dusk dawn").variant(x => x.ild(-9))

// Frogs at the pond behind you, and an owl far off to the left
frogs: s("click*4?0.4").lpf(1200).azimuth(170).distance(5).seed("pond").gain(.1)
  .sections("pond meadow'")
owl: note("<~ [~ ~ a3 [a3 e3]] ~ ~>").s("hum").azimuth(-70).distance(8)
  .attack(.05).release(.5).gain(.12).sections("pond dawn")

// A 4 Hz binaural beat in the theta range, only in the deep of the night: keep the volume low
drone: note("<a1 a1 f1 g1>").slow(2).s("sine").binaural(4)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.22).sections("meadow pond")

// Slow choir chords under the stars: Am, F, Dm, E
choir: note("<[a2,e3,c4] [f2,c3,a3] [d3,f3,a3] [e2,b2,g#3]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<oo ah oo oh>").attack(3).release(4).space("hall").gain(.18)
  .exceptSections("dusk")

sketches.name: Sea Cave
sketches.description: A walk into a sea cave and out again, about two and a half minutes. Waves are heard through the rock, water drips from the roof at points around you, a hum steps from the centre of your head out into the stone, and bells of light from the entrance drift apart in cents, falling an octave on the way back. On speakers the 180-degree bars of the hum nearly vanish.
sketches.source:
setcpm(48/4)
song("entrance@4 cave@8 deep@8 cave'@8 exit@4", "once")
tempomap("0:12 28:12 32:9")

// The sea outside: open at the entrance, heard through the rock further in
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.5).occlude(bysec("entrance:.1 exit:.1 *:.5")).gain(.3)

// Water dripping from the roof at points around you, in a stone space
drips: s("drip*8?0.6").azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(rand.range(20, 70))
  .distance(rand.range(1, 3)).seed("cave").space("church").room(.5).gain(.16)
  .exceptSections("entrance")

// The cave hum: 0 degrees centred, 90 looser, 180 diffuse and nearly gone in mono
hum: note("[a1,e2]").s("triangle").iphase("<0 90 180 90>")
  .attack(2).sustain(1).release(2).gain(bysec("deep:.28 *:.22")).exceptSections("entrance exit")

// Bells of light from the entrance: earsh raises the right ear and lowers the left by 6 cents each
// On the way back out, the bells fall an octave
light: note("<e5 ~ b4 ~ c5 ~ a4 ~>").s("sine").fm(2).fmh(2.76).earsh(12)
  .decay(3).sustain(0).release(3).space("church").gain(.1)
  .sections("entrance cave exit").variant(x => x.add(-12))

sketches.name: Storm Overhead
sketches.description: Headphones on: two storms. The first comes in from your left, passes right over your head and rolls away behind you; after a lull, a second crosses the other way, from your right. In each storm the rain swells and fades and the gusts are wide and enveloping. A light drizzle fills the calm, and the piece clears and slows to a stop.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)
song("calm@4 storm@8 lull@4 storm'@8 clearing@8", "once")
tempomap("0:20 28:20 32:16")

// A light drizzle in the quiet sections
drizzle: s("rain").intensity(.2).gain(.2).sections("calm lull clearing")
breeze: s("pink").icorr(.3).hpf(200).lpf(800).gain(.02).sections("calm lull clearing")

// Each storm is eight bars: the rain swells and fades
rain: s("rain").intensity("<.25 .35 .55 .8 .8 .6 .4 .25>").gain(.28).sections("storm")

// Thunder moves bar by bar: around you, up overhead and closer, then away
// The second storm is a variant that crosses from the right
thunder: s("<[~ lt] ~ [lt ~ ~ lt] lt [lt lt ~ lt] lt ~ [~ lt]>").speed(.5).lpf(300)
  .azimuth("<-120 -90 -45 0 30 90 140 170>").elevation("<10 20 45 70 70 45 20 10>")
  .distance("<9 7 4 2 2 4 7 9>").room(.9).size(.95).gain(.5)
  .sections("storm").variant(x => x.azimuth("<120 90 45 0 -30 -90 -140 -170>"))

// Gusts: unrelated noise in each ear, wide and enveloping, rising and falling with the storm
wind: s("pink").icorr(.15).hpf(200).lpf(sine.range(400, 2000).slow(8))
  .gain("<.03 .05 .08 .12 .12 .08 .05 .03>").sections("storm")

// A dark pad and a slow bass underneath: Em, C, Am, B
pad: note("<[e3,b3,d4] [e3,b3,d4] [c3,g3,b3] [c3,g3,b3] [a2,e3,c4] [a2,e3,c4] [b2,f#3,a3] [e3,b3,d4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(sine.range(500, 1600).slow(8))
  .attack(.6).release(1.5).room(.6).gain(.14)
bass: note("<e2 e2 c2 c2 a1 a1 b1 e2>").s("sine").attack(.3).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Campfire Stars
sketches.description: A night by the fire, about three and a half minutes. The fire burns in front of you, crickets chirp in the dark, an owl calls from behind and stars twinkle high above. A drone's phase turns slowly between your ears, while a guitar widens bar by bar, then narrows again later in the night. The fire burns down to embers at the end. All rates stay below 3 Hz.
sketches.source:
setcpm(52/4)
song("dusk@4 fire@16 stars@8 fire'@16 embers@4", "once")
tempomap("0:13 44:13 48:10")

// The fire in front of you, burning down at the end; the woods all around
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(bysec("dusk:.25 embers:.15 *:.35")).density(6).distance(1.5).gain(.24)
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(-100).distance(6).gain(.06)
owl: note("<[~ ~ d4 [d4 a3]] ~ ~ ~>").s("hum").azimuth(150).distance(7)
  .attack(.05).release(.5).gain(.14).sections("stars embers")

// irate turns the phase between the ears, in turns per second
// All rates stay below 3 Hz, so no pulse warning is needed
drone: note("[d2,a2]").s("sine").irate("<.25 .5 1 .5>")
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.24)

// From about 1 to 30 ms the guitar stays on the leading side but grows wider each bar
// Later in the night, a variant runs the widths the other way
guitar: note("<[d3 a3 d4 f4 a4 f4 d4 a3] [bb2 f3 bb3 d4 f4 d4 bb3 f3] [c3 g3 c4 e4 g4 e4 c4 g3] [a2 e3 a3 c#4 e4 c#4 a3 e3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(.8).sustain(0).release(1)
  .itd("<1 6 12 6>").lpf(2200).room(.4).gain(.2)
  .sections("fire stars").variant(x => x.itd("<12 6 1 6>"))

// Stars twinkling high above, each in its own place
stars: n(irand(8).segment(8)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.8).seed("embers")
  .s("sine").decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.5)
  .azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(60).distance(4).room(.6).gain(.08)
  .sections("stars fire' embers")

sketches.name: Dawn Chorus
sketches.description: Headphones on: from first light to sunrise in under three minutes. The dawn chorus is placed all around you, a lark rises and crosses high overhead, and a morning flute and harp play straight ahead, the flute climbing an octave as the sun comes up. A quiet 10 Hz binaural beat in the alpha range, for waking gently, rises and fades once over the piece. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)
song("first_light@4 birds@8 chorus@16 birds'@8 chorus'@16 sunrise@4", "once")
tempomap("0:21 52:21 56:17")

// The dawn chorus all around you: each bird has its own place, and they join one by one
robin: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.26)
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(60).elevation(25).distance(4).gain(.22).exceptSections("first_light")
blackbird: s("bird").slow(5).azimuth(150).distance(6).gain(.18).sections("first_light birds sunrise")

// A lark crossing high overhead once in each chorus, gliding between positions
lark: s("bird").slow(4).azimuth(saw.range(-90, 90).slow(16)).elevation(50).distance(8).posglide(.5).gain(.16)
  .sections("chorus")

// A dove cooing behind you on the left
dove: note("<[~ e4 [e4 c4] ~] ~>").s("hum").azimuth(-120).distance(5)
  .attack(.05).release(.4).gain(.12).sections("birds sunrise")

// A 10 Hz binaural beat in the alpha range: quiet, rising and fading once over the piece
drone: note("<g2 g2 e2 c2>").slow(2).s("sine").binaural(10)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(env("0 .16@6 0", "song"))

// A morning flute and a harp, straight ahead: G, Em, C, D
// In the second chorus the flute climbs an octave with the sun
flute: note("<[g4@2 a4 b4 d5@3 b4] [e5@2 d5 b4 g4@4] [e4 g4 a4 b4 a4@2 g4 e4] [d4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.6).release(.5).delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.24)
  .sections("chorus").variant(x => x.add(12))
harp: note("<[g3 b3 d4 b3] [e3 g3 b3 g3] [c4 e4 g4 e4] [d3 f#3 a3 f#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.2)
  .exceptSections("first_light")

sketches.name: Pine Wind
sketches.description: Wind through a pine forest, about three minutes from calm to dusk. Nothing is panned, yet the gusts wander between your ears, as each ear has its own low-pass sweeping the other way. Trunks creak around you, a woodpecker drums far off, and a pad sends alternate partials to each ear, complete only when both ears hear it. A wooden flute plays in the glade between the gusts.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)
song("calm@4 gusts@16 glade@8 gusts'@16 dusk@4", "once")
tempomap("0:15 44:15 48:12")

// Wind through the pines: each ear has its own low-pass, sweeping in opposite directions
// The level stays put; only the brightness of the gusts wanders between the ears
wind: s("pink*4").hpf(200).attack(.2).release(.4)
  .lcutoff(saw.range(500, 3000).slow(8)).rcutoff(isaw.range(500, 3000).slow(8))
  .gain(bysec("gusts:.06 gusts':.06 *:.03"))

// Trunks creaking around you, a woodpecker far to the right, a jay behind
trunks: s("~ ~ creak ~").mask("<1 0 0 1 0 1 0 0>")
  .azimuth("<-60 80 -120 30 150 -30 90 -150>").distance(4).gain(.14).exceptSections("calm")
woodpecker: s("rim*8 ~ ~ ~").mask("<0 1 0 0 0 0 1 0>").speed(2).lpf(3000)
  .azimuth(80).distance(7).gain(.16).sections("gusts glade")
jay: s("bird").slow(6).azimuth(-140).elevation(30).distance(6).gain(.14)

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the partials between the ears: each ear hears a thinner chord
pad: note("<[e3,b3,e4,g4] [c3,g3,c4,e4] [d3,a3,d4,f#4] [b2,f#3,b3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").earsplit("harmonics").lpf(1600)
  .attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).room(.6).gain(.12).exceptSections("calm")

// A wooden flute, the same in both ears, in the glade and at dusk
flute: note("<[b4@3 a4] [g4@2 e4@2] [a4@3 f#4] [e4@4]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.3).sustain(.6).release(1).room(.6).gain(.2).sections("glade dusk")

sketches.name: Whale Song
sketches.description: Headphones on: a dive of about three and a half minutes. You sink below the waves to where a whale circles slowly beneath you, gliding from note to note. A calf answers from the other side, bubbles rise past your ears and a 2 Hz binaural drone hums in the deep. Then you rise back towards the surface.
sketches.source:
setcpm(44/4)
song("surface@4 descent@8 deep@16 calf@8 ascent@4", "once")
tempomap("0:11 36:11 40:8")

// The open sea above you: loud at the surface, faint in the deep
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.3).elevation(50).distance(4)
  .gain(bysec("surface:.3 ascent:.3 *:.12"))

// The deep: a 2 Hz binaural drone, below the 3-30 Hz warning range
deep: note("<d1 d1 bb0 c1>").slow(4).s("sine").binaural(2)
  .attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.28).exceptSections("surface")

// A whale circling slowly beneath you, once around in the deep, gliding from note to note
whale: note("<[d3@2 a3@4 g3@2] ~ [f3@3 c4@3 a3@2] ~>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .mono(1).glide(.4).vib(3).vibdepth(.2).attack(.6).sustain(.8).release(2)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(16)).elevation(-30).distance(8).posglide(1)
  .room(.8).gain(.2).sections("descent deep calf")

// A calf answers from the other side
calf: note("<~ [a4@3 d5@5] ~ [g4@4 c5@4]>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .mono(2).glide(.3).vib(4).vibdepth(.2).attack(.4).sustain(.6).release(1.5)
  .azimuth(120).elevation(-20).distance(10).room(.8).gain(.12).sections("calf")

// Bubbles rising past your ears
bubbles: s("drip*8?0.3").azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(rand.range(-40, 40))
  .distance(1.5).seed("bubbles").gain(.1)

sketches.name: Hidden Spring
sketches.description: A spring bubbling up in a clearing, about two minutes. The splashes are white noise, but between the ears they carry a faint tune (Huggins pitch); each ear alone hears only water. After the first pass a quiet sine plays the first phrase so you know what to listen for; after the second, the pad drops out and the tune is left alone in the water. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.
